identity.name: Masquerading as Common Software with Suspicious Process Creation
identity.summary: An attacker masquerades a malicious binary as a common system utility like 'explorer.exe' to evade detection, then executes it to establish persistence. Cortex should detect the process name mismatch

biocs.name: Process Masquerading as Common Utility
biocs.description: Detection of process creation where the executable name mimics a legitimate system utility like 'explorer.exe' but originates from an unusual path
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'explorer.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name not contains 'Windows\System32\explorer.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name not contains 'Program Files\Windows\explorer.exe'

abiocs.name: Suspicious Process Start from Temp Directory
abiocs.description: Detection of process execution from a temporary directory with a name mimicking a legitimate system utility
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains '/tmp/'
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'explorer.exe'
| filter actor_process_image_name not contains 'Windows\System32'
